summary: This study looks at the current status of islet alpha cell function, which involves cells in the pancreas that help control blood sugar, in patients with type 2 diabetes. The research is currently Recruiting and aims to enroll 1000 participants. Sponsored by Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University, this Phase 3 trial studies the effects of treatment on newly diagnosed patients.

facts.sponsor: Nanjing First Hospital, Nanjing Medical University
